message.canopycavern.welcome_tip: You received the Canopy Field Guide! Right-click it (or press G) for survival tips, gear recipes, and co-op shelter blueprints.
screen.canopycavern.field_guide.title: Canopy Cavern Field Guide
guide.canopycavern.section.basics.title: 1. Vanilla-Plus Exploration
guide.canopycavern.section.basics.body: No RPG stats or skills: survive through smart preparation, cooperative shelters, and upgraded armor or alpine tools.
guide.canopycavern.section.climate.title: 2. Climate, Micro-Weather & Comfort
guide.canopycavern.section.climate.body: High ridges bring frostbite chills and deep humid caves sap stamina. Warm by a lit campfire or inside an enclosed roof to recover.
guide.canopycavern.section.gear.title: 3. Specialty Armor & Tools
guide.canopycavern.section.gear.body: Wear Peak Thermal gear for frost immunity, Mossweave for humid & hot caves + cave Speed, or craft Flare Torches & Relic Compasses.
guide.canopycavern.section.world.title: 4. Revamped Biomes & Villager Cities
guide.canopycavern.section.world.body: Seek redesigned Timber Villages, Crystal Citadels, Treetop Bastions, Echoing Mineshafts, and friendly patrolling Village Sentinels.
blueprint.canopycavern.trailside_camp.de: Quick open timber lean-to with lit campfire, storage & crafting.

advancements.canopycavern.conquer_minesh: Find the sprawling Echoing Mineshaft Hub deep underground.
